title: The Apology in a Group Chat
title_ja: グループチャットでの謝罪
fact_notes: 登場人物、具体的な出来事・観察・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Four students were working together on a presentation about their town's public transportation.
sentences.ja: 4人の生徒が町の公共交通について共同で発表の準備をしていた。

sentences.en: They divided the work and used a private group chat to exchange information after school.
sentences.ja: 作業を分担し、放課後は非公開のグループチャットで情報を交換した。

sentences.en: One evening, Mei discovered that a graph in her section had been replaced without an explanation.
sentences.ja: ある晩、メイは自分の担当部分のグラフが説明なしに差し替えられていると気づいた。

sentences.en: She immediately sent a message accusing another member of ignoring her contribution to the project.
sentences.ja: すぐに別のメンバーが活動への自分の貢献を無視したと責めるメッセージを送った。

sentences.en: The next morning, the member explained that he had noticed an incorrect label on the graph.
sentences.ja: 翌朝、そのメンバーはグラフのラベルの誤りに気づいたと説明した。

sentences.en: He had created a corrected version because he thought the presentation was due that evening.
sentences.ja: その晩が提出期限だと思い、修正版を作っていた。

sentences.en: However, the actual deadline was two days later, so there had been time to discuss the change.
sentences.ja: しかし実際の期限は2日後で、変更を話し合う時間があった。

sentences.en: Both students realized that they had acted on assumptions that they had not checked.
sentences.ja: 二人は確認していない思い込みに基づいて行動したと気づいた。

sentences.en: Mei decided to apologize directly to the member during their lunch break at school.
sentences.ja: メイは学校の昼休みに、そのメンバーへ直接謝罪することにした。

sentences.en: She described exactly which accusation she regretted and listened to his explanation without interrupting.
sentences.ja: どの非難を後悔しているか具体的に述べ、遮らずに説明を聞いた。

sentences.en: The other student also acknowledged that replacing her graph without notice had caused unnecessary confusion.
sentences.ja: 相手も知らせずにグラフを差し替えたことが不要な混乱を招いたと認めた。

sentences.en: Together, they agreed to explain the misunderstanding briefly to the other members of the group.
sentences.ja: 二人でグループのほかのメンバーにも誤解を簡潔に説明することにした。

sentences.en: Before continuing their work, the group established a simple rule about making changes to shared materials.
sentences.ja: 作業再開前に、共有資料の変更に関する簡単なルールを定めた。

sentences.en: Members could suggest corrections immediately, but they would normally discuss major changes with the original author.
sentences.ja: すぐ修正案を出せるが、重要な変更は原則として元の作成者と相談することにした。

sentences.en: They also recorded the deadline in a place where everyone could easily find it.
sentences.ja: 全員が容易に見つけられる場所に締切も記録した。

sentences.en: These small adjustments helped them resume the project with a clearer understanding of their responsibilities.
sentences.ja: 小さな調整によって、互いの責任を明確に理解して活動を再開できた。

sentences.en: Mei learned that an apology can involve more than simply saying that one is sorry.
sentences.ja: 謝罪は単に申し訳ないと言う以上のことを含み得ると学んだ。

sentences.en: Acknowledging a specific mistake can help clarify what needs to change in a relationship.
sentences.ja: 具体的な間違いを認めることで、人間関係で何を変えるべきか明確にできる。

sentences.en: Listening to another person's account may also reveal circumstances that were previously unknown.
sentences.ja: 相手の話を聞くと、それまで知らなかった事情が分かることもある。

sentences.en: For the group, repairing trust meant developing better ways of working together in the future.
sentences.ja: グループにとって信頼の修復とは、今後のより良い協力方法を作ることでもあった。

options: Her graph had been replaced without an explanation.
The town's buses had stopped running.
Her teacher had lost the entire project.
questions.explanation_ja: グラフが説明なく差し替えられた。

questions.prompt: Why had the member created a corrected graph?
options: He wanted to remove every graph.
He was collecting pictures for a different project.
He noticed a wrong label and believed the deadline was near.
questions.explanation_ja: ラベルの誤りと締切の思い込み。

options: Their teacher had changed the actual deadline.
They had relied on unverified assumptions.
The graph could never be corrected.
Group chats should always be deleted.
questions.explanation_ja: 確認していない思い込みだった。

options: She asked a teacher to finish the project.
She refused to discuss what happened.
She identified her accusation and listened to his explanation.
questions.explanation_ja: 具体的に謝り、説明を聞いた。

questions.prompt: What did the other student acknowledge?
options: Changing the graph without notice caused confusion.
The graph had been entirely correct.
Mei had never contributed to the project.
questions.explanation_ja: 無断変更が混乱を招いたと認めた。

questions.prompt: What rule did the group establish?
options: Discuss major changes with the original author.
questions.explanation_ja: 重要変更は元の作成者と相談する。

questions.prompt: Why did they put the deadline in an accessible place?
options: So only one person could see it.
So all members could check it instead of guessing.
To make the deadline later automatically.
To stop members from discussing their work.
questions.explanation_ja: 全員が確認できるようにした。

questions.prompt: What does acknowledge mean in the form Acknowledging?

options: An apology is unnecessary when a project is difficult.
Group members should never make corrections.
The best way to resolve disagreements is to ignore them.
Repairing trust involves understanding mistakes and improving cooperation.
questions.explanation_ja: 過ちを理解し協力方法を改善する。

grammar.explanation_ja: 過去完了の受動態で発見前の差し替えを示す。
soは結果、過去完了はその時点までの状態。
more thanは単に〜以上という意味。

discourse.role_ja: 思い込みと実際の期限を対比。
修正提案と大きな変更のルールを対比。
相手の説明を聴く価値を追加。

paraphrases.source: One evening, Mei discovered that a graph in her section had been replaced without an explanation.
paraphrases.rewrite: Mei found that someone had changed her graph without telling her why.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 理由を知らせず差し替えられた。

paraphrases.source: However, the actual deadline was two days later, so there had been time to discuss the change.
paraphrases.rewrite: The real deadline was later, which meant they had enough time to talk about the revision.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 相談する時間はあった。

paraphrases.source: She described exactly which accusation she regretted and listened to his explanation without interrupting.
paraphrases.rewrite: She specified the accusation she wished she had not made and allowed him to finish his account.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 具体的な非難を謝罪し説明を最後まで聞いた。

paraphrases.source: Mei learned that an apology can involve more than simply saying that one is sorry.
paraphrases.rewrite: Mei understood that expressing regret in words is not the whole of an apology.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 謝罪は言葉だけではない。

無断変更が混乱を生んだ。
